answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 69134 Country: U.A.E. Title: Dua for health and financial condition Question: I am suffering from my health and my financial condition. Since last year I am troubled by many problems. I need relief from them. Please give me some dua or make an istikharah for me. Answer ID: 69134 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1056/1002/SN=11/1437) Read the following two verses extensively. In-shaAllah you shall get rid of the problems: حَسْبُنَا اللّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
